annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1220 of 26 July 2021 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/76 as regards harmonised standards on safety rules for the construction and installation of firefighters lifts and behaviour of lifts in the event of fire
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1220 of 26 July 2021 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/76 as regards harmonised standards on safety rules for the construction and installation of firefighters lifts and behaviour of lifts in the event of fire
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission implementing decision updating the list of harmonised standards under the Lifts Directive 2014/33/EU, replacing EN 81-72:2015 and EN 81-73:2016 with EN 81-72:2020 and EN 81-73:2020 on firefighters lifts and lift behaviour in fire. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Deletes entries 9 and 10 of Annex I to Decision (EU) 2021/76
Inserts EN 81-72:2020 and EN 81-73:2020 as harmonised standards conferring presumption of conformity
Withdrawal of older standard references deferred to 27 January 2023
Enters into force on publication in the Official Journal
